races.paceDynamic: With Lethal Blast withdrawn, this race loses its confirmed front-runner and becomes a tactical affair. Poetic Jack is the most likely to take early position given his prominent style, but he may not be keen to make all. The lack of natural pace-setters suggests a steadily-run race where horses will be bunched up turning for home. This moderate tempo heavily favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, particularly those with proven finishing speed like Southbank and Elvetham.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Hold-Up Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Jack leads but the pace stays modest through halfway
scenarios.body: The field remains compact into the straight allowing closers to unleash their finishing kicks. Hold-up specialists with tactical speed get ideal racing room to strike late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Jack gets an uncontested lead and quickens clear
scenarios.body: He builds enough advantage to hold off late challenges despite the modest early gallop. His previous course win and Hollie Doyle's tactical nous prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the field goes too slowly and kicks too late in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where horses fail to pick up properly on the slower surface. Previous course form and fitness levels become crucial factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Speed Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses dispute the early lead unexpectedly
scenarios.body: The unexpected pace sets up perfectly for a closer with the best turn of foot. The race opens up dramatically in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Poetic Jack could steal this if allowed uncontested lead under Hollie Doyle's tactical guidance
Southbank's 64-day absence may leave him short of peak fitness despite strong historical course form
Elvetham's wide draw in stall 11 could prove costly if the pace collapses and racing favours the inside
Multiple hold-up horses may find themselves with too much to do if Poetic Jack gets away with soft fractions
Top Star's headgear switch from hood to cheekpieces suggests connections expect improved focus

races.paceDynamic: Lion Ring is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace without pressure. The prominent runners Alashos and Porfin will track behind, but neither is aggressive enough to challenge early. With most of the field comprised of hold-up horses including Harry Brown, Mighty Ruler, Mintana, Big Time Rascal, Fai Fai, Battle Point, Daley T and Comedian Leader, there will be a wall of horses coming from off the pace in the final two furlongs. This tactical setup strongly favours the front runner Lion Ring and any prominent racers who can secure good early positions, as the hold-up brigade will face a traffic nightmare.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lion Ring gets his usual uncontested lead and maintains stamina over 6f
scenarios.body: The lone leader sets fractions to suit himself while the pack of hold-up horses gets into trouble behind, allowing him to kick clear when the challengers are still organizing. His two classified wins this year prove he can sustain a strong pace when unopposed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swarm
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the large group of closers can organize effectively
scenarios.body: The wall of hold-up runners gets a clean run through and overwhelms the front end with superior class and finishing speed. Quality horses like Harry Brown and Mighty Ruler benefit from their higher ratings when given racing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Alashos or Porfin can stalk Lion Ring closely and outkick him in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect trip behind the leader while avoiding the traffic that snares the hold-up horses. They combine tactical advantage with enough early speed to stay clear of trouble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Emerges Clean
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and a lightly-raced improver finds clear running
scenarios.body: An unfancied runner like Big Time Rascal benefits from returning fresher opponents getting into trouble, while his patient style allows him to pick up the pieces. The handicapper may have underestimated recent improvement.

watchPoints.text: Lion Ring could get loose on the lead if rivals are slow to organize early, making him very difficult to peg back
Traffic problems likely in straight with nine hold-up runners converging simultaneously from midfield and rear positions
Mintana needs cheekpieces refitted after going without them in disappointing last run, headgear change crucial
Big Time Rascal showing signs of improvement after poor 2023, worth noting if getting clear run from rear
Harry Brown's 64-day absence following two poor runs makes him hard to trust despite superior course record

runners_data.name: Honour Your Dreams
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who hasn't won for some time but represents the same stable as Desdemona and could benefit from the early pace battle.

runners_data.name: She Went Whoosh
runners_data.note: Prominent type who finished fourth over C&D last week but remains winless in 11 attempts for current connections.
runners_data.comment: Didn't run badly when fourth over C&D last week but is now 0-11 for Scott Dixon
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't run badly when fourth over C&D last week but is now 0-11 for Scott Dixon and her overall profile remains unappealing.

races.paceDynamic: Wedgewood and Desdemona will dispute the early lead from the off, with both confirmed front runners likely to set a genuine gallop over this minimum trip. She Went Whoosh and Honour Your Dreams will track the pace in second rank, while hold-up merchant Tuscan Point settles towards the rear under Cosgrave. The dual pace angle should create an honest tempo that won't collapse, but equally won't be suicidal over 5f. This race shape favours prominent racers who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the early battle between the two leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Duel Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Wedgewood and Desdemona engage in a sustained speed duel from flagfall
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes testing and weakens both protagonists, allowing those tracking in the slipstream to come through. Prominent racers like Honour Your Dreams and She Went Whoosh benefit most from the honest gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tuscan Point Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If Cosgrave gets Tuscan Point into a rhythm and the early pace is only moderate
scenarios.body: The hold-up horse gets the perfect setup to unleash his finishing kick in the final furlong. His recent Southwell win suggests he's in prime form to capitalise on tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wedgewood Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Wedgewood can dictate terms from the front without serious pressure from Desdemona
scenarios.body: The course winner uses his tactical speed to control the gallop and kick clear when it matters most. His proven C&D form and good draw give him every chance to dominate.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Desdemona Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Desdemona can get first run on the field and establish a clear advantage
scenarios.body: The dual 5f Polytrack winner uses her natural speed to build an unassailable lead that holds under pressure. Her proven track record at the trip gives her the edge.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Wedgewood and Desdemona go too fast early - both could weaken dramatically in the final furlong
Monitor Tuscan Point's position turning for home - if he's too far back the race might develop too quickly for him to recover
Observe how aggressively Ryan Kavanagh rides Desdemona early - his 5lb claim could be crucial if she gets into a speed duel
Check if She Went Whoosh can improve on last week's effort - her poor record for Dixon makes her hard to trust despite reasonable form
Watch Honour Your Dreams settling - if he can avoid the early pace battle he could outrun his odds at a decent price

races.paceDynamic: Bergamo Gold will be the sole pace-setter from the gates, with Mythical Bird and Lady McC sitting handy in second flight. The majority of this field are hold-up performers (Ammoony, Flightofthephoenix, Guendolen, Willow Wood, Ghost Story, Gnocchi) which creates a tactical disadvantage with too many needing the same back-to-front finish. With one uncontested leader over this staying trip on standard Polytrack, Bergamo Gold can dictate fractions and kick clear, while the mass of hold-up horses will be fighting for racing room in the straight. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Bergamo Gold gets soft fractions and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The Charlie Johnston runner can control the tempo completely and has enough in hand to resist late challengers over this trip. The wall of hold-up horses behind creates perfect cover for the leader to exploit.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Mythical Bird or Lady McC can sit close enough to pounce
scenarios.body: These prominent runners avoid the traffic issues that will plague the hold-up brigade while staying within striking distance of Bergamo Gold's steady gallop. They get first run on the leader when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If one of the back markers gets a dream run through
scenarios.body: The bunch finish behind the leaders creates opportunities for a well-timed late thrust, particularly from Flightofthephoenix who has solid course form. Racing luck becomes crucial with so many needing the same gap.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Bergamo Gold goes too slow and gets swamped by everything
scenarios.body: The leader misjudges the fractions completely allowing the entire field to close up and create a sprint finish. Multiple hold-up horses get their chance in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Bergamo Gold getting generous early fractions with no pressure - could steal this completely
Monitor the first half-mile splits - if too pedestrian the hold-up brigade gets genuine chances
Check how Mythical Bird handles the step back to AW after six-month turf break
Watch for traffic problems in straight with seven hold-up horses needing same gap
Observe if Lady McC settles better with tongue-tie on stable debut after Irish struggles

races.paceDynamic: Dalmally is the only confirmed front runner in this 12-runner field and should be allowed an uncontested lead at sustainable fractions over this mile trip on the all-weather. The lack of natural pace means the early gallop will be modest, with prominent racers like Secret Road and My Boy Harry likely tracking behind Dalmally through the first half. This sets up a tactical affair where the real race begins from the 3f pole as the hold-up horses try to close from deep positions. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those who can sit handy, as they'll have the tactical advantage when the tempo lifts in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Kicks
scenarios.trigger: If Dalmally gets soft fractions and finds improvement off a break
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets first run in the straight and holds on as closers struggle to make up ground from too far back. Prominent trackers benefit most from being in the right position when the race develops.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Handy Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the modest pace allows prominent racers to strike first in the straight
scenarios.body: Horses positioned 2nd-4th through the race have the perfect stalking trip and can respond when Dalmally comes under pressure. Hold-up horses are caught too far back when it matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pedestrian gallop sets up perfectly for a late-running type
scenarios.body: The slow tempo means stamina types get ideal conditions to unleash their finishing kick from the back. Mr Fustic or Antiquity could benefit from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Folds Early
scenarios.trigger: If Dalmally stops quickly after setting the pace
scenarios.body: An early leader collapse creates chaos and opens the door for any horse with tactical speed to capitalise. The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole.

races.paceDynamic: Bella Bisbee will likely lead from the gates with Daisy Roots, Portman Blue, and Kit Gabriel providing prominent support in the early stages. The pace should be genuinely run but sustainable, as none of the front-runners are excessive speed merchants and the 7f distance allows tactical positioning. The midfield and hold-up brigade including Virtue Patience, Chola Empire, Bold Suitor, Spirit Lead Me, Havana Touch, and Blue Collar Lad will track the leaders before launching their challenges. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers and those with tactical speed, as they can position close enough to strike without relying on a strong pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but not excessive, allowing prominent racers to stay within striking distance
scenarios.body: The front-runners maintain control while those tracking closely can time their challenges perfectly. Bella Bisbee and Daisy Roots benefit from their forward positions, while Kit Gabriel can improve from his handy berth.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with the prominent horses going too fast
scenarios.body: The pace setters weaken in the final furlong, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past with late runs. Virtue Patience and Havana Touch capitalize on their recent winning form from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Bella Bisbee gets an easy lead and the prominent horses fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The winner controls the race from the front and kicks clear when the pace lifts, with the field unable to reel her back. Her recent C&D victory gives her the confidence to dictate terms throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: The well-handicapped horses with low weights get first run on the leaders and sustain their challenges. Blue Collar Lad's 117lbs burden becomes a significant advantage in a slowly-run affair.

races.paceDynamic: Lunar Power is the sole recognized front-runner and will set the gallop without immediate pressure, creating a moderate pace through the early stages. The bulk of the field including Divot, The Colorist, Fullforward, Upepo, Sir Patchy and Skimming Along are hold-up horses who will track behind Imperial Cult in the prominent group. This setup creates a classic scenario where the pace will be honest but not punishing early, before intensifying from the home turn as the large pack of closers fan out. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing kicks, as they'll have plenty of cover and a target to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows the large contingent of closers to stay in touch
scenarios.body: Lunar Power's honest gallop sets up perfectly for the seven hold-up horses who can unleash finishing kicks from off the pace. The winner emerges from the pack of closers with Divot, Upepo and Skimming Along best positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Lunar Power maintains his lead and the closers fail to coordinate their challenge
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets an easy time in front and maintains enough in reserve to hold off a disorganized finish from the hold-up brigade. Imperial Cult's prominent position gives him the best chance to chase down Lunar Power if the leader weakens.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Imperial Cult Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runner can bridge the gap between leader and hold-up horses
scenarios.body: Imperial Cult's position just behind Lunar Power allows him to track the pace without getting trapped behind the wall of closers. His three C&D wins in 2024 give him tactical advantage over this trip and surface.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Charge Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop turns into a crawl, allowing the most patient hold-up horses to produce devastating late runs. This scenario particularly suits The Colorist and Sir Patchy who are proven slow-starters with finishing kicks.

watchPoints.text: Lunar Power sets the entire pace dynamic - if he goes too fast or too slow, it transforms the race completely
Imperial Cult's fitness after 188 days off and immediate impact under new trainer George Baker needs monitoring
The large group of seven hold-up horses could get bunched up turning for home, creating traffic problems
Upepo and The Colorist both have strong C&D winning form that could prove decisive in a tactical finish
Fullforward and Skimming Along return from extended breaks with fitness questions that may be exposed over this staying trip
